acceptance.description: Complete current AE/log inventory and future-write minimization. Preserve removal of all eight subject-bearing route writers and fixed-code/numeric console boundaries across entry, queues, services and objects. Define one fixed versioned operational aggregate shape: trusted configured environment/scope, closed operation/status enums and bounded numbers; no subject/session/capability/site key, raw payload/error/URL, arbitrary event/page/item/order/channel/region or sensitive free-form dimensions. Dormant exported ledger helpers cannot bypass policy/minimization. Keep optional behavioral AE held and canonical ledger delivery/measurement unchanged; absence of visitor IDs alone is not anonymity.

Use the existing snapshot path with POST body context and verified-principal subject/profile SID, a principal-only preferences alias with exact-current-SID legacy SDK translation, and principal-derived WebSocket routing on both hosts with bounded canonical site-key subprotocol alongside existing shopper capability. Keep only canonical tenant routing in WS query. Preserve separate site-key and shopper authority, customer/method/owner allowlists, duplicate/conflicting/malformed-selector refusal before effects, W04 grants and W05 acknowledgment/epoch/ABA/cache/withdrawal fences, original buffered browsing/time provenance and compatible old endpoint controls. Headers/protocols remain sensitive; arbitrary caller-chosen URLs and historical logs are not magically erased.

Minimize monitor diagnostics at origin and every returned/KV/webhook/legacy-read projection. Use closed codes and bounded numeric detail; hostile exception text and malformed/legacy stored fields cannot escape. Preserve tenant-scoped operator access/no-store, substantive checks and health outcomes, cooldown, failed-recovery retries and honest alert delivery receipts. Separate necessary retry/recovery state from optional diagnostic capture/retention. Missing/unapproved/expired policy blocks dependent optional persistence/egress including after awaits, not necessary erasure/refusal/security recovery. Do not silently repurpose the old raw-diagnostic-preservation W07.04 oracle as an obligation to leak.

Use strict existing canonical TENANTS/configuration authority for exact non-secret operational destination/schema/access/retention descriptors and separately validated telemetry policy categories, without numerical defaults or a new framework. Do not feed telemetry deadlines into behavioral external.* copy/expiry cohorts. Hold optional sinks before binding access when scope/policy is missing or malformed. Stamp-level health must not fabricate a default tenant or broadcast duplicates. Name desired AE datasets explicitly per environment and disable persistent/invocation observability by default pending approved controls. Local manifest/configuration is intent, not actual resource existence, access enforcement, expiry or deployed readback.

Preserve truthful current and historical erasure/destination obligations. Reuse W06 durable pinned destination/configuration/generation receipts and audited reconciliation; newly configured telemetry obligations survive config removal without invented historical ownership or provider verification. Historic AE/log data and unknown mappings remain explicitly unresolved, never auto-deleted or claimed erased by future minimization. Correct existing API/integration instructions concisely, including new SDK transports, permitted schema/policy gates and remaining retention/access/history limits; notices do not substitute for processing/deletion obligations.
